Direction for questions :

The number of innings played and runs scored by each of the ten batsmen—A, D, G, H, J, K, R, S, and Y—are displayed in the scatter plot which follows. The number of runs a batsman scores per number of innings played is a batman's average.
For instance, the scatter plot's point (10, 150) designates one of the ten batters who played 10 innings and scored 150 runs. Given order of names is also the increasing order of run scorers i.e. Y is the highest scorer, then R is the second highest scorer and so on.

What is the average of the top most run scorer among all?
